about: Fuerteventura, Sotavento (backlog E04.S12; Documentation/reports/spots/sotavento/PLAN.md). Read by tools/map/spot_build.py. Boxes are [west, south, east, north] in the spot's frame (metres east and north).
name: Fuerteventura, Sotavento
crs_name: REGCAN95 / UTM zone 28N (the Canary Islands' frame)
origin_about: The game's origin: the René Egli Center on the beach at Playa Barca, the PWA World Tour's event site (OpenStreetMap: 28.13578 N, 14.24477 W).

shore_profile.about: Depth below mean sea level (m) at a distance from the waterline (m) where EMODnet's 115 m cells are blind: the beach face 4 % (tan beta 0.04) and 50 m deep at 1500 m (3.3 %), Marrero-Rodriguez et al. 2021. Blended into EMODnet between blend_from_m and blend_to_m.

photo_waterline_about: The PNOA photo was flown near low water (the lagoon drained but for its channels, the bar a wide strip: as in the photos of 24 September 2021 at 09:24); mean low water is about 0.86 m below mean sea level (mean range 1.72 m). The heights measured from the photo's sea waterline start here. Checked against the reference photos (Documentation/reports/spots/sotavento/PLAN.md, section 6).

lagoon.about: The lagoon and the bar shaped from the aerial photo's colours (decision D1: by hand now, the CNIG LiDAR later). Heights above mean sea level (m). The lagoon fills around high water (mean HW about +0.86 m, springs about +1.25 m): at spring high water it is one sheet of water 35 to 85 cm deep and the bar a thin strip of sand (the high-tide photos of 24 September 2021, 15:20, and from Playa Barca and the Risco del Paso hill).

buildings.about: OpenStreetMap's building outlines (ODbL); floors from OSM where tagged, otherwise guessed, and the landmarks' from photos (the Paradisus and Zel hotel blocks by the René Egli Center: eight and six floors in the aerial photos of 24 September 2021).

sea.about: The sea from the region (tools/map/spot_sea.py, P3): EMODnet over Fuerteventura, Gran Canaria's north and the African coast, the far fetch along the near grid's edges, the ocean swell's exposure; the checkpoints for the realism check (the SIMAR points' positions are read from the coastal study's map, approximate).

checkpoints.name: SIMAR 10 (off the bar's apex, mean Hs 0.56 m, Ts 5.7 s)
SIMAR 09 (off El Matorral, mean Hs 0.87 m, Ts 9.5 s)
the start, in front of the judges' tower

water_level_about: The session's water level above mean sea level until the tide is chosen in the menu (P4): between mean and spring high water, so the lagoon has water (35 to 85 cm at spring high water, the spot dossier).
